chunks: From him, from Fudaylah, from Aban, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him saying: 'Whoever buys something from the khums, God will not excuse him, for he has bought what is not permissible for him.'

key_terms.مَا لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ: What is not permissible for him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on buying items from the khums?
ai.summary: In the context of Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the conditions under which purchasing from the khums is valid, warning that unauthorized acquisition constitutes a violation of divine rights. It underscores the principle that khums assets are sacred trusts, and improper purchase renders the buyer liable for divine retribution as they possess what is not lawfully theirs. This ruling is foundational in distinguishing between the Imam's share and the general community's share of khums.
